Emerald City Leadership Network
Membership Intake Form – Application Date: September 2025

Applicant Name:
Please describe a recent professional challenge you navigated.

Had a batch of outdoor motion sensors. First install, they were sluggish when the temperature dropped. Had to pull them all, send them back, and reinstall a new set. Took three days total. The new ones are holding fine so far.
Please describe a recent project where your work directly supported a community member or local business.

Farmhouse out in Timber Verge. They were putting in a wood-pellet heater in the kitchen and needed a new circuit. The old main meter box was pretty weathered, so I replaced the whole box first to handle the new load safely. Everything's up to code now.
What interests you about joining the Emerald City Leadership Network?
Heard the Winkie Works Guild folks talk about it. Sounds like a good way to hear what other trades are dealing with, maybe share notes on supply runs or tricky installs. Could be useful.
